import copy
def beads():
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    out={}
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['pixels']==4 and n['color'] not in ('N','G','B','c'):
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            out.setdefault(n['color'],[]).append((min(rs),min(cs)))
    return out
before = beads()
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':41,'col':26}])
mid = beads()
d1=[]
for c in set(before)|set(mid):
    if before.get(c,[])!=mid.get(c,[]):
        d1.append((c, before.get(c,[]), mid.get(c,[])))
print("green1(41,26) diff:", d1)
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':41,'col':23}])
after = beads()

for c in set(mid)|set(after):

print("red1(41,23) diff:", d2)
